시편-141-1.title: 시편 141장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-141-1.exegesis: PSALM 141 Psa 141:1-10 . This Psalm evinces its authorship as the preceding, by its structure and the character of its contents. It is a prayer for deliverance from sins to which affliction tempted him, and from the enemies who caused it.
